profile.title: Profile settings
profile.subtitle: Keep your learning level and profile details up to date. Reader highlights use the range between your current and target CEFR levels.

profile.cannotClearGoal: The current API cannot clear a learning goal. Choose a replacement level.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: These details are managed with your account and cannot be changed here.

cefrCard.title: Current learning level
cefrCard.hint: Saving either CEFR level refreshes personalized article highlights.

A1.title: Beginner
A1.description: Understand and use simple everyday expressions and basic phrases for fundamental communication.

A2.title: Elementary
A2.description: Communicate in routine tasks and familiar everyday topics such as family, shopping, and work.

B1.title: Intermediate
B1.description: Understand main points of authentic texts, express opinions, and handle most common situations.

B2.title: Upper Intermediate
B2.description: Read complex texts, grasp nuanced arguments, and discuss technical topics fluently.

C1.title: Advanced
C1.description: Use language flexibly and effectively for demanding academic, professional, and social purposes.

C2.title: Mastery
C2.description: Understand virtually everything with ease and express spontaneously, precisely, and idiomatically.
